rows.text: Liberty waive Laney-Hamilton, ink Fauthoux to multiyear deal

rows.text: Sabrina Ionescu (left foot), Satou Sabally (cyst), Rebecca Allen (left leg) and Marine Fauthoux (left knee rehab) have been ruled OUT for tomorrow’s game against the Washington Mystics.
